hints.title: Extremal Occurrence Span
hints.text: The degree of an array is determined by the maximum frequency of any element. For any element achieving this maximum frequency, the shortest contiguous subarray containing all its instances spans from its first to its last occurrence.

hints.title: First And Last Occurrence Record Invariant
hints.text: Recording the first occurrence index, last occurrence index, and count for each distinct element allows computing minimal span in one inspection.

hints.title: Tri-Property Tracking Minimum Span Procedure
hints.text: Record the first index, last index, and frequency for every number during a single pass. Determine the maximum frequency across all elements. For each element achieving that maximum frequency, calculate last index minus first index plus one, and return the minimum calculated span.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every possible subarray takes O(N^3) time or O(N^2) time with prefix frequencies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking first index, last index, and counts takes O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space, finding the answer in a single follow-up pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should realize that only elements with the maximum frequency need to be considered and their minimal span is simply right[x] - left[x] + 1.
